units.name: ScriptSceneRestoreBall
units.summary: Restore the court display, reset ball elevation and motion, then place the ball and select mode one. Projection sign controls the alternate X placement.

units.name: ScriptSceneSetupDisplay
units.summary: Save scroll/CHR latches, clear scroll and disable rendering. Select actor/team appearance graphics and palette/nametable based on court projection; position the action actor at fixed court coordinates.

units.name: ScriptActorLoadRecord
units.summary: Use actor_roster_index as script ID and actor_acquire_delay as its record index. Compute a sixteen-byte record pointer, increment the index and stop on $FF. Load animation, coordinates, continuation pointer and role. Role one also loads trajectory targets and acceleration; projection sign mirrors X around $02F8.

units.name: ScriptActorTick
units.summary: Ignore inactive actors. Role zero waits for its delay; moving roles update motion, synchronize displayed Y with elevation and wait for animation completion. Call the record continuation indirectly, then load the next sixteen-byte script record.

units.name: ScriptActorContinuation
units.summary: Tail jump through the record continuation pointer. The caller supplies the return frame. The following entry selects CHR1 through the fixed interface.

units.name: SpecialSceneRestart
units.summary: Choose announcement by the special-scene selector, update the reserved actor and common play state, then after the delay install the scripted player formation and check menu input.

units.name: SpecialSceneTransfer
units.summary: Advance the scene, assign formation-facing selectors and transfer the ball action from its owner to the reserved actor through the shared pairing service.

units.name: SpecialSceneActorReady
units.summary: Wait for the reserved actor animation, set facing three and start a randomized moving target. Advance scene_step with a $B4-frame action window.

units.name: SpecialSceneActionWindow
units.summary: Update play and identify the controlling pad. Automatic play waits for actor 11 inside a narrow X/elevation window on every fourth frame; a human uses B. Initialize the ball target, action actor and trajectory state before entering the common action service.

units.name: SpecialSceneTargetReset
units.summary: Put actor 11 at fixed sixteen-bit screen coordinates and elevation. Its update chooses team grouping, steps motion and reverses signed velocity once per countdown.

units.name: SpecialSceneMoveTarget
units.summary: Choose the target actor descriptor by possessing side, update actor 11 motion and reverse signed elevation/X velocity once per countdown. Reload its saved randomized duration.

units.name: SpecialSceneRandomMotion
units.summary: Reset the target and clear its reversal flag. Choose one of eight four-byte velocity records and a random duration 8..15, saving that duration for the next reversal.
